query:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `product_drafts` (
	`id` int AUTO_INCREMENT NOT NULL,
	`productId` int,
	`name` varchar(200) NOT NULL,
	`slug` varchar(200),
	`categoryId` int,
	`subcategoryId` int,
	`price` decimal(10,2),
	`promoPrice` decimal(10,2),
	`unit` varchar(50),
	`badge` varchar(50),
	`stockQty` int,
	`availability` enum('in_stock','out_of_stock','preorder') DEFAULT 'in_stock',
	`shortDescription` text,
	`descriptionHtml` text,
	`sku` varchar(100),
	`barcode` varchar(100),
	`metaTitle` varchar(200),
	`metaDescription` text,
	`tags` text,
	`promoStartDate` timestamp,
	`promoEndDate` timestamp,
	`currentStep` int NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
	`completionPercentage` int NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
	`createdAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT (now()),
	`updatedAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT (now()) ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
	CONSTRAINT `product_drafts_id` PRIMARY KEY(`id`)
);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `product_media` (
	`id` int AUTO_INCREMENT NOT NULL,
	`productId` int NOT NULL,
	`type` enum('image','video') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'image',
	`url` text NOT NULL,
	`mimeType` varchar(50),
	`fileSize` int,
	`sortOrder` int NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
	`isMain` int NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
	`createdAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT (now()),
	`updatedAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT (now()) ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
	CONSTRAINT `product_media_id` PRIMARY KEY(`id`)
);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `product_specs` (
	`id` int AUTO_INCREMENT NOT NULL,
	`productId` int NOT NULL,
	`key` varchar(100) NOT NULL,
	`value` text NOT NULL,
	`sortOrder` int NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
	`createdAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT (now()),
	`updatedAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT (now()) ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
	CONSTRAINT `product_specs_id` PRIMARY KEY(`id`)
);
